technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Average processes for melting steel and producing rolled profiles.

# Included processes
This data set includes the materials and resources needed for melting steel and producing rolled steel profiles used in Switzerland. The rolled steel profiles are produced in Europe and Switzerland and transported to the regional Swiss storage. Water and electricity demand are modelled with average Europe data. Data were collected by questionnaires.
